title: Africa–Asia silver exports
note: Silver, including silver plated with gold or platinum, unwrought or in semi-manufactured forms, or in powder form (HS 7106). This is the heading aggregate, including powder, unwrought silver, and semi-manufactured silver. The six-digit parts are not stored separately. Reporter exports to the other region only. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade. A missing year is not zero and must not be filled from another year. Customs weight is kilograms, not troy ounces, and is not the London silver price. Net weight and quantity can both be kilograms and still differ; they must not be substituted. A null net weight is not zero. Quantity 0 with unit code -1 is not a measured kilogram weight. This is not precious-metal ores (HS 2616), not base metals clad with silver (HS 7107), not silver compounds (HS 2843), not waste and scrap (HS 7112), not jewelry (HS 7113), not gold (HS 7108), and not platinum (HS 711011 or HS 711019). Mine production is absent from this database, not zero. The Pink Sheet benchmark stored with this trade is silver (UK), 99.9% refined, London afternoon fixing, in US dollars per troy ounce. Prior to July 1976 the series was Handy & Harman. Grade prior to 1962 was unrefined silver. It is not gold, not platinum, not palladium, and not the HS 7106 customs unit value. The Pink Sheet has no palladium or rhodium series. Türkiye to Libya in 2025 has two kilogram weights that differ. Ghana to Korea in 2023 and 2024 each have quantity 0 with unit code -1. Uganda to the United Arab Emirates in 2024 and 2025 each have two kilogram weights that differ. Tanzania to the United Arab Emirates in 2025 has quantity 0 with unit code -1. The United Arab Emirates returned no rows against Africa in 2024 and 2025. A reported row under USD 1 million is not zero trade.
